all_distinct(xs: List[int]) -> bool =
  ex all_distinct([]) == True
  ex all_distinct([1, 2, 3]) == True
  ex all_distinct([4, 4]) == False
  let n = xs.len()
  for i in range(0, n)
    for j in range(i + 1, n)
      if xs[i] == xs[j]
        return False
  True

make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  post all_distinct(out)
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  ex make_ids(5, 1).len() == 5
  let base = seed % 1000000007
  let ids = par for i in range(0, n)
    base + i
  ids

test_all_distinct() =
  assert all_distinct([1, 2, 3])
  assert all_distinct([4, 4]) == False

test_make_ids() =
  assert make_ids(4, 9) == make_ids(4, 9)
  assert make_ids(6, -3).len() == 6
  assert all_distinct(make_ids(10, 42))
